1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario describes a problem where labels and text annotations do not follow their associated SequenceFlow (connection) when the connected shape (e.g., a sub-process) is resized. 2.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when a connection (SequenceFlow) with an associated label or text annotation is re-laid out after the connected subprocess is resized.
